title: The Fright Crawl | Indianapolis Halloween Weekend Pass 2026 | All 4 Crawls
description: All four Indianapolis Fright Crawls on one pass: Thursday kickoff, the Friday takeover, the Saturday day party and Halloween night. 16+ of Indianapolis's best bars, no cover anywhere, a host and a live map at every crawl, for less than buying the nights separately. Passes are strictly limited and Halloween night sells out first, so lock in the whole weekend now.
